note: Final held-out test set for the agent configuration after development round 9 (stricter verifier). Questions written by an independent subagent from a description of the project and the list of the 118 already-used questions only (not the tools or prompts); expected behaviour, accept, must_not and requires were added by Claude before any run and are not edited afterwards. Results of this set are reported as they come; no change is made to the agent for this set.
